description: Acme United Corporation is a global supplier of innovative safety solutions and cutting technology. The company operates a diversified brand portfolio serving school, home, office, hardware, sporting goods, and industrial markets, with a strong presence in first aid, medical products, and spill containment.
business_model: Global product supplier and brand aggregator serving consumer and industrial markets via retail, e-commerce, and direct-to-consumer channels.
financial_highlights: Q1 2026: Net sales of $52.3 million (14% increase YoY).
Q1 2026: Net income of $1.0 million (40% decrease YoY due to tariffs and operating expenses).
January 15, 2026: Acquired assets of My Medic for approximately $14.6 million.
July 2025: Invested $6.0 million in a new manufacturing and distribution facility in Tennessee.
October 1, 2025: Acquired a cutting and sharpening product line in Germany for $1.6 million.
value_proposition: Providing high-quality, innovative safety and cutting tools through a diversified brand portfolio that serves both consumer and industrial sectors worldwide.
rfp_strengths: Extensive global distribution network across North America, Europe, and Africa
Diversified brand portfolio covering multiple industrial and consumer niches
Proven track record of strategic acquisitions to expand product capabilities
Established manufacturing presence in the US (Tennessee)
rfp_weaknesses: Recent decline in net income profitability
Vulnerability to international tariff-related cost surges
Small core corporate headcount relative to global scale
opportunities: Expansion of direct-to-consumer (DTC) and retail channels
Further integration of the My Medic tactical and trauma product line
challenges: Tariff disruptions affecting cost of goods sold
recent_news: June 17, 2026: Board approved cash dividend of 16 cents per share.
April 23, 2026: Reported Q1 2026 financial results showing 14% sales growth.
January 15, 2026: Completed acquisition of My Medic assets.
